record.dic_text:
01909 Hadad`ezer {had-ad-eh'-zer}

源自 01908 和 05828; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Hadadezer 9; 9

哈大底謝 = "哈大是有相助的"
1) 利合的兒子, 敘利亞-瑣巴的王, 為大衛王的軍隊擊敗.
record.edic_text:
01909 Hadad`ezer {had-ad-eh'-zer}

from 01908 and 05828;; n pr m

AV - Hadadezer 9; 9

Hadadezer = "Hadad is help"
1) son of Rehob, a king of Syria-Zobah defeated by David's army
